summary: Frontend E2E of the new GuidedTour (doctor /app and parent /portale) at desktop 1920, tablet 768 and mobile 390. Navigation, step targets, back/next/dots, keyboard, skip/escape persistence, restart entry points and the done screen all work. Found 2 bugs: (1) CRITICAL, fixed by me: POST /api/onboarding/tour was on the doctor-only `api` router (doctor_ctx), so parents got 403. Parents could never save tour_done, and the tour reopened on every portal load. (2) HIGH, still open: the spotlight dimming is invisible because the tour-spotlight element's opacity stays at ~0.

critical.issue: Returned 403 for the parent role because the route was registered on `api` (dependencies=[doctor_ctx]). FIXED by moving it to `public_api` (current_user only). Verified: parent 200, doctor 200, unauthenticated 401; backend/tests/test_onboarding_tour.py has 7 tests, all passing.

ui_bugs.issue: The spotlight is effectively invisible. Its computed opacity is 0 (inline style opacity: 0.057) on every step for both doctor and parent, so the 9999px darkening shadow and ring don't show and the real element is not visually highlighted. RCA: Spotlight returns either the backdrop motion.div (initial opacity 0, animate opacity 1) or the spotlight motion.div at the same tree position. React reuses the same motion component, so when rect arrives a few frames later the opacity animation is cut off at ~0 and the new `animate` has no opacity key. Fix: add opacity: 1 to the spotlight's animate (and initial={{opacity:0}}), or give the two branches different keys (key='backdrop' / key='spot').

issues: The header row 'BENVENUTO, DOTT.SSA FOTI' and 'Salta il tour' both wrap onto 2 lines; consider whitespace-nowrap on the skip button and truncating the name
The card covers about 55% of the viewport, so the spotlighted target is mostly hidden behind it (acceptable, but consider scrolling the target into the area above the card)
Bottom-right card overlaps the spotlighted visits list and vetrina preview (expected with large targets)

passed_checks: Doctor: reset, then /app auto-opens after about 1s (not visible at 0.5s) on tour-step-1 targeting agenda-panel (bbox matches with PAD 10)

Doctor: next goes to step2 consult-hub, step3 /app/visite visits-page, step4 /app/impostazioni?sezione=vetrina account-section-vetrina; tour-extra-link goes to /app/cassa with the tour still open; back goes to step3 /app/visite; tour-dot-1 goes to /app; dot-4 shows the 'Concludi' label; then tour-step-done 'Tutto pronto'; tour-finish-btn closes the tour and /api/auth/me returns tour_done true; reload does not reopen it
Keyboard: ArrowRight/ArrowLeft move between steps; Escape closes and sets tour_done true
Skip sets tour_done true and the tour stays closed after reload; restart works from TopBar tour-open-button and from settings-tour-btn

Parent (after the fix): auto-open, portal-overview, /portale/documenti documents-area, /portale portal-simple-box, /portale/trova-specialista specialists-directory, extra link to /portale/messaggi, done screen; finish/skip/escape persist; restart works from portal-tour-open-btn and portal-settings-tour-btn
Responsive 390x844 and 768x1024: card docked at the bottom, no horizontal overflow (scrollWidth equals viewport), buttons 44px high and inside the viewport, done screen centered on tablet
action_items: Fix the GuidedTour Spotlight opacity stuck at 0: add opacity to the spotlight animate or key the backdrop and spotlight branches separately
Optional: prevent the mobile header and 'Salta il tour' from wrapping on the tour card

critical_code_review_comments: server.py: the onboarding route sat on the doctor-only router even though the feature targets parents too (fixed). Check any other shared-role endpoints for the same mistake.
useTour.end only saves when tour_done === false, and the error is swallowed (.catch(() => {})). That is why the parent 403 was silent. Consider logging or surfacing the failure.
TopBar tour-open-button is hidden below sm (hidden sm:flex). On the doctor mobile view the only restart point is Settings, which is acceptable.
test_credentials: From /app/memory/test_credentials.md: doctor medico@mantmed.it, parent genitore.demo@example.com. No lockouts.
seed_data_creation: None. Both demo accounts were left with tour_done true.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Use page.request.post /api/auth/login and then POST /api/onboarding/tour {completed:false} to reset. Check the spotlight with getComputedStyle(tour-spotlight).opacity, which should be 1 once fixed. Parent reset now returns 200.
rca of the issue: Parent 403: the route was registered on `api` (APIRouter with dependencies=[Depends(doctor_ctx)]). Spotlight: the backdrop and spotlight motion.div share the same element instance, so the opacity animation from the backdrop branch is interrupted near 0 and never restored.
